headline: CPPIB Invests $50 Million in Toronto AI Firm Beacon Software
summary: CPPIB has invested $50 million in Toronto artificial intelligence firm Beacon Software through its growth equity unit.
why: Major pension fund investments in technology startups highlight institutional backing for high-growth artificial intelligence sectors.
